meta.name: rag-architect
meta.description: Designs and implements production-grade RAG systems by chunking documents, generating embeddings, configuring vector stores, building hybrid search pipelines, applying reranking, and evaluating retrieval quality. Use when building RAG systems, vector databases, or knowledge-grounded AI applications requiring semantic search, document retrieval, context augmentation, similarity search, or embedding-based indexing.

copy.tagline: 构建生产级 RAG 系统，实现语义搜索与文档检索
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为 AI 应用搭建文档检索与上下文增强的 RAG 管道
copy.tagline_en: Build production-grade RAG systems for semantic search and document retrieval
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build RAG pipelines for document retrieval and context augmentation in AI applications

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你设计 RAG 系统：拆分文档、生成向量、配置向量库、构建混合搜索、重排序结果，并评估检索质量。
howto.when: 当你需要构建 RAG 系统、向量数据库或知识库应用，涉及语义搜索、文档检索、上下文增强等任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 RAG 系统，用于内部知识库问答。
say.note: Claude 会分析需求并给出架构方案。

say.text: 如何选择分块策略和向量数据库？
say.note: Claude 会参考参考指南给出建议。

say.text: 评估我的检索管道，使用 precision@k 和 recall@k。
say.note: Claude 会生成评估代码并设定目标。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you design RAG systems: chunk documents, generate embeddings, configure vector stores, build hybrid search, apply reranking, and evaluate retrieval quality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to build RAG systems, vector databases, or knowledge-grounded AI applications involving semantic search, document retrieval, context augmentation, etc.

say_en.text: Design a RAG system for internal knowledge base Q&A.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze requirements and propose architecture.

say_en.text: How to choose chunking strategy and vector database?
say_en.note: Claude will consult reference guides for recommendations.

say_en.text: Evaluate my retrieval pipeline using precision@k and recall@k.
say_en.note: Claude will generate evaluation code and set targets.
